❯ Without using any tools, write a 600-word story about a lighthouse keeper. Plain text only.

● The Keeper of Gannet Rock

  Every evening at a quarter past six, Elias Varn climbed the hundred and twelve steps of the Gannet Rock lighthouse. He
  counted them out loud. He had done it for thirty-one years, and in all that time the number had never changed, but he
  still counted, because the counting was part of the job, like trimming the wick or wiping salt off the lens.

  The lighthouse stood on a black spur of rock four miles off the coast. A supply boat came every second Thursday with
  flour, tinned fish, paraffin, and letters. For the first decade the letters came from his sister in Aberdeen. After
  she died they came from nobody, and the boatman, a quiet man named Callum, began bringing newspapers instead. Elias
  read them weeks late and found that this suited him. By the time he heard about a crisis, it was usually over.
